Upload a large file successfully

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::FileClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let req_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"file":"eyJwcm9tcHQiOiAibGFyZ2UgdHJhaW5pbmcgZGF0YSJ9Cg==","filename":"large_training_data.jsonl","purpose":"fine-tune"}"#).unwrap();
    let req = serde_json::from_value(req_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.create_file(req).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.id);
}
```
